_readme: Unique characters for Triều Ca (Zhaoge). Includes Di Xin, Daji, and Bi Gan.

characters.name: Trụ Vương (Di Xin)
characters.title: Bạo Chúa Nhà Thương
characters.description: The last king of the Shang dynasty, corrupted by Daji. Tall, incredibly strong, but decadent and cruel.
characters.appearance_prompt: tall muscular ancient chinese emperor, extremely handsome but with a cruel sinister expression, wearing opulent dark red and gold imperial robes, heavy bronze and gold armor accents, twelve pearl crown, dark aura, holding a bronze sword
characters.negative_prompt: text, watermark, modern clothing, weak, old, beard

concept_art.style_prompt: highly detailed character concept art, upper body portrait, dramatic cinematic lighting, looking arrogantly down at viewer

sprite.style_prompt: full body game character sprite, isometric 2.5D angle, standing tall combat idle pose, clean clear silhouette, game asset

dialog_portrait.style_prompt: visual novel character sprite, half-body portrait, standing posture, looking at viewer, clean edges, game UI asset

characters.name: Đát Kỷ (Daji)
characters.title: Cửu Vĩ Yêu Hồ
characters.description: The nine-tailed fox spirit possessing Su Daji, the primary antagonist manipulating Di Xin.
characters.appearance_prompt: breathtakingly beautiful ancient chinese empress, seductive but dangerous, long flowing black hair, wearing revealing luxurious silk robes in crimson and pale pink, subtle fox-like eyes, nine ethereal phantom fox tails behind her
characters.negative_prompt: text, watermark, ugly, modern clothing, warrior armor

concept_art.style_prompt: highly detailed character concept art, seductive portrait, dramatic cinematic lighting, ethereal glowing tails

sprite.style_prompt: full body game character sprite, isometric 2.5D angle, elegant floating pose, clean clear silhouette, game asset

dialog_portrait.style_prompt: visual novel character sprite, half-body portrait, seductive posture, looking directly at viewer, clean edges, game UI asset

characters.name: Tỷ Can (Bi Gan)
characters.title: Trung Thần Thất Tâm
characters.description: The loyal uncle of Di Xin who possessed a 'Seven-Aperture Heart' and was executed by having it cut out.
characters.appearance_prompt: righteous ancient chinese court official, middle-aged with a dignified scholar beard, wearing traditional green and black Shang dynasty official robes, holding a jade tablet, expression of profound sorrow and righteous anger
characters.negative_prompt: text, watermark, modern, armor, weapons, young

concept_art.style_prompt: highly detailed character concept art, upper body portrait, dramatic cinematic lighting, somber mood

sprite.style_prompt: full body game character sprite, isometric 2.5D angle, standing holding tablet pose, clean clear silhouette, game asset

dialog_portrait.style_prompt: visual novel character sprite, half-body portrait, respectful posture, holding jade tablet, looking at viewer, clean edges, game UI asset
